patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Reports an active "pro" entitlement to the Flutter side so every Pro feature (calibration, custom white balance presets, extra measurement modes, ad free usage) is unlocked without a RevenueCat purchase.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features (custom clock fonts, floating lock styles, extra tap actions, quick settings tile, ...) and removes the ads that are shown to non-paying users.
